topic: Use Claude as a social media manager for your business Instagram: sharpen the bio, plan a week of content, and draft on-brand DM replies, in 3 steps

pick.topic: Use Claude as a social media manager for your business Instagram: sharpen the bio, plan a week of content, and draft on-brand DM replies, in 3 steps
pick.angle: Stop paying a social media manager for the boring parts: here's the exact Claude setup that does the bio, content plan and DM replies (and where it still needs a human)
pick.why: 226k views, 5,071 likes and 6,709 comments (about 3% comment rate) on a business-focused Instagram topic. It's squarely Instagram growth plus an AI workflow, easy to teach in 3 steps, and not covered recently.

research.tool: Claude (claude.ai) as a chat assistant for Instagram bio, content-plan and DM-draft work. Optional: a third-party Instagram connector from Claude's Connectors directory (Metricool, Windsor.ai, Supermetrics, PostFast, Upload-Post), added via Customize > Connectors.
research.availability: Claude has a Free plan ($0) for drafting in chat. Pro is $20/mo ($17/mo billed annually). Third-party connectors need their own account (e.g. Metricool has a free tier for 1 brand). Instagram needs a Business or Creator account. Web, desktop and mobile apps. I could not confirm region limits.
steps: Step 1 (bio, no connector needed): open claude.ai and start a new chat. Paste your current Instagram bio, who your audience is, and your current offer. Ask for 5 bio options, each with a clear value line, a proof point and a CTA. Pick one and paste it into Instagram yourself (Edit profile > Bio).

Step 2 (content plan): in the same chat, give Claude your brand guidelines, 3-4 content pillars and one campaign goal. Ask: 'Build a 7-day Instagram plan with format (Reel/carousel/Story), topic, hook, caption direction and CTA for each post.'

Step 3 (DM replies): paste your FAQs, prices, tone of voice and 5-10 real past DMs. Ask Claude to draft on-brand reply templates for the common cases (pricing, booking, shipping, complaints, collabs). Copy and send them yourself, or keep them as saved replies.

Optional upgrade (this is the 'connect Instagram' part): in Claude go to Customize > Connectors, click the + button, find an Instagram-capable tool in the directory (e.g. Metricool, Windsor.ai, Supermetrics, PostFast), click Connect and sign in. Link Instagram inside that tool first. Claude can then read your analytics, and with some connectors schedule posts or reply to comments after you approve.
Custom-connector route for tools not in the directory: Customize > Connectors > Add > Add custom connector. Paste the tool's MCP server URL and sign in. Free accounts get one custom connector.
facts: There is no official first-party Instagram connector from Meta or Anthropic. Windsor.ai says Claude's directory had no connector from Meta or Instagram when checked on 20 October 2026 (vendor page, not Anthropic).

aidigitalspace.com says neither Anthropic nor Meta offers a native Claude-to-Instagram integration. What exists is connectors from social media tools, some listed in Claude's directory, plus custom connectors added by server URL.
Meta's official MCP server is for ads. It runs at mcp.facebook.com/ads and has been in free open beta since 29 April 2026 (ferrerponseti.com). It is not for posts, comments or DMs.

Windsor.ai, Supermetrics and Metricool are listed as Anthropic-verified in Claude's directory (antwork.io). Windsor and Supermetrics read Instagram data but don't publish. Metricool can schedule and update posts.
Metricool: free for 1 brand, paid plans from $25/mo (aidigitalspace.com test, Oct 2026).
PostFast is a community connector, not a verified one. It allows one private reply per comment within seven days (aidigitalspace.com, postfa.st).
Connector setup path per Anthropic docs: Customize > Connectors. In the desktop app, select Customize in the sidebar, then Connectors (claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started).

Claude pricing, Nov 2026: Free $0, Pro $20/mo ($200/yr, about $17/mo), Max $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo (formerly Max 20x, renamed 30 Oct 2026). Team Standard seat $25/mo ($20 billed annually). Third-party summaries of Anthropic's pricing page agree.
Free includes Sonnet and Haiku but no Claude Code or Opus. Pro adds Claude Code and Opus.

Gray Bay Marketing's workflow: give Claude brand guidelines, content pillars and one campaign goal, then ask for a 7-day plan with format, topic, hook, caption direction and CTA per post. It also suggests pasting your bio with your audience and current offer.
Instagram's messaging rules let a business reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message (usecarly.com).
Reading or sending DMs through the Instagram API needs Meta Advanced Access approval (usecarly.com). This is why most connectors only handle comments or one private reply.
do_not_claim: 'Claude can now manage your Instagram' or 'Claude has a native Instagram integration'. Unverified: no official Anthropic or Meta Instagram connector found. Only third-party connectors exist.

That Claude reads and replies to your DMs by itself. Most connectors can't read DMs. Some (Upload-Post, Blotato, Zernio) advertise DM features, so check each one. DM sending is limited by Meta approval and the 24-hour window.
That Claude posts to Instagram with no extra tool. Without a connector it can't reach your account.
Do not say it's 'fully automated'. Connectors ask for your approval before writing to Instagram.
Do not cite InstantDM's stats (60-80% DM open rate, 15-30% conversion). They are vendor marketing numbers with no neutral source.
Do not tie the reel to Higgsfield MCP 'avatar & video editing'. That's a sponsor or ad angle from the other creator, unrelated to the Instagram claim, and I did not verify it.
Do not say 'Instagram' is an Anthropic-built connector. Anthropic's own connectors are things like Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Slack and GitHub.
Do not name an exact time or date for when this launched. I found no launch announcement.
Do not say custom connectors are free-plan-blocked or unlimited. Free allows one custom connector. A blog claims custom connectors need a paid plan, but Anthropic-based sources say Free gets one.
criticism: Instagram connectors are third-party tools, so you give another company access to your account. Anthropic itself warns that custom connectors connect to unverified services that Claude can act inside (quoted in diyaa-albouzan.com). Verify any connector before you connect it.

Rate-limit and bot-detection risk: Meta briefly suspended the No Kings Coalition's Instagram account, blaming an automated security system triggered by Claude pulling data very fast (NewsBytes, Oct 2026). Meta later said Claude was not at fault.
DM automation is gated by Meta's Advanced Access approval and the 24-hour reply window, so late replies can bounce.
AI-written bios, content plans and DM replies still need a human for brand voice, facts (prices, stock, policies), sensitive complaints and final posting.
Connectors that publish or reply usually cost extra beyond Claude (e.g. Metricool paid plans from $25/mo).

ui.platforms: Web (claude.ai), desktop app, iOS and Android apps for the chat steps. Connector setup is on web and desktop (Customize page). Instagram profile edits happen in the Instagram app.
apps: Optional: Metricool or Windsor.ai website, or Claude's Connectors directory
screens: Claude web: left sidebar with New chat, Chats and Projects, and 'Customize' (holds connectors, skills and plugins). The chat box is at the bottom with a '+' button at its left for attachments and connectors. I could not verify exact placement or whether the default is light or dark, so show a real screen recording.

Customize > Connectors: lists your connected apps with toggles, plus a '+'/Add button that opens the Connectors directory. An Instagram-capable tool can be searched by name (e.g. 'Metricool', 'Windsor'). Click Connect and sign in on the vendor's page.

Chat result: Claude replies with a structured 7-day table or list (Day, Format, Hook, Caption direction, CTA) and a few bio options. DM drafts appear as a list of short reply templates. With a publishing connector Claude shows a draft and waits for your yes before writing to Instagram.
Instagram app: Profile > Edit profile > Bio field, where you paste the chosen bio.

research.visuals: Best shown as a screen recording of a Claude chat: paste a bio, get 5 rewrites, then the 7-day plan table, then 3 DM reply drafts. Optionally add a short clip of Customize > Connectors with the directory open. Don't show a fake 'Instagram' connector tile, because none exists from Meta or Anthropic. Use real tool names instead.

real_pages.show: How to Connect Claude to Instagram

research.notes: Verdict is 'adjust': the workflow works, but the 'Claude can now manage your Instagram' framing is misleading. Anthropic and Meta have no native Instagram integration. Bio, plan and DM drafting work in plain chat on the Free plan, with copy-paste. Real Instagram access comes only through third-party connectors, which have their own accounts, costs and Meta limits. Suggested honest angle: 'Claude does the thinking, you do the posting. Connect a tool like Metricool only if you want it to schedule.' Sources disagree on a few things: whether Free users can see the directory (one source says no, most say yes), whether custom connectors need a paid plan (Free gets one), and Claude's plan naming. Anthropic renamed Max 20x to Ultra ($200) on 30 Oct 2026, so avoid 'Max 20x'. I could not open claude.com/pricing or the connector listings directly, so the pricing figures come from third-party pages that quote Anthropic's pricing page. Check the live page before screen-recording. Don't hard-code the 'show' text on real_pages until you've confirmed it on the live page. Check that the claude.com/pricing page really shows 'Pro' and a price before using it. The Windsor.ai and Metricool pages are vendor marketing, so use them only to show that the connector route exists.
